observations: Photo 0 shows a Bosch brand steam iron, white and grey in color.
The Bosch iron has '2400W' and 'Sensixx'x DA30' printed on the side.
Photo 1 shows a Tefal brand steam iron, white and blue in color.
The Tefal iron has 'Easygliss' and 'High Precision' printed on the side.
Both irons appear used with some surface scuffs, consistent with 'Tokunbo' (imported used) status.
The soleplates (bottom) of the irons are not shown.
Power cords are visible but the plugs are not clearly shown.

claims.evidence: The items show wear consistent with imported used goods, but origin cannot be proven remotely.
Both the Bosch in photo 0 and Tefal in photo 1 are designed with water tanks and steam controls.
Subjective term; internal condition and performance are unknown.

risks.proof: Video of the iron being plugged in and reaching operating temperature.
Clear photos of the underside/soleplate of each iron.

risks.risk: Water tank leakage or steam blockage
risks.proof: Video showing the iron filled with water and successfully emitting steam without leaking from the body.

proof_requests: Photos of the soleplates for both the Bosch and Tefal irons.
A video showing both irons powered on, heating up, and producing steam.
Photos of the electrical plugs to check for compatibility and damage.
response.reason: The items are clearly identified by brand and model type. While their functional state is unproven, they can be priced at the worst-case value for non-functional or 'parts only' units until proof of operation is provided.
